clusters.title: Art psychotherapists are already regulated | Letters
clusters.neutral_headline: Art psychotherapists are already regulated | Letters

items.title: Art psychotherapists are already regulated | Letters
items.standfirst: Elizabeth Donnelly notes that art therapists occupy a different regulatory position from counsellors and psychotherapistsWe welcome the discussion about public protection, professional accountability and the importance of appropriate regulation within counselling and psychotherapy (Letters, 5 November). However, we feel it is important to highlight a distinction that may be helpful to readers.Art psychotherapists are already a statutorily regulated profession in the UK, regulated by the Health and Care Professions Council (HCPC). The HCPC regulates 15 health and care professions, including arts therapists (art psychotherapists, art therapists, drama therapists, music therapists) and the titles art therapist and art psychotherapist are legally protected. Practitioners must meet HCPC registration requirements, standards of proficiency, conduct and ethics, and continuing professional development requirements. Continue reading...

clusters.title: Gen X is in worse health than boomers – and I have a few theories as to why | Emma Beddington
clusters.neutral_headline: Gen X is in worse health than boomers – and I have a few...

items.title: Gen X is in worse health than boomers – and I have a few theories as to why | Emma Beddington
items.standfirst: People in my age group are experiencing poorer physical and mental health than their elders at the same stage. Is this down to UPFs and booze, or something more complicated?I almost choked on my bird-food breakfast recently, reading that gen Xers are in worse health than boomers. Research by the UCL Centre for Longitudinal Studies, on approximately 8,000 participants aged about 50 from the 1970 British Cohort Study, found that my generation is experiencing “worse physical and mental health across adulthood than earlier-born generations”.Come on! How? We have better health education and pharmaceuticals than any previous generation, we’ve been browbeaten into cultivating our microbiomes and hitting our step counts, harassed to stand up (sitting’s worse than smoking!), jump around (protect your bones!) and pop creatine (unsure). Yet we’re still unhealthier than our elders? Continue reading...

clusters.neutral_headline: Trump administration planning to reimburse doctors treating vaccine ‘injury’

items.title: Trump administration planning to reimburse doctors treating vaccine ‘injury’
items.standfirst: Experts warn that sweeping changes elevate health secretary RFK Jr’s anti-vaccine agenda and personal profitThe Trump administration is finalizing a rule to reimburse doctors who diagnose, treat and counsel patients with side effects from vaccines in what experts believe is an attempt to undermine trust in vaccines and to create an evidence base on their purported risks.Robert F Kennedy Jr, the secretary of the US Department of Health and Human Services (HHS), also announced the creation of a vaccine “injury” research center at the National Institutes of Health and has sought to reshape the Vaccine Injury Compensation Program (VICP) – actions that point to Kennedy’s longtime activism against vaccination as well as the profits he and his network have made from vaccine lawsuits. Continue reading...
